item.title: Aleph Alpha Releases 78B Kolibri Open-Weight Model
item.description: Aleph Alpha releases a German-English MoE model with 78.1 billion parameters, 3.46 billion active per token and Apache 2.0 licensing.

item.title: Study Finds Chinese Models Echo Official Views on Taboo Topics
item.description: An Aleph Alpha benchmark finds Qwen, DeepSeek and Kimi often refuse or reproduce official positions across 967 politically sensitive prompts.

item.title: ⚡ 14 quick hits — Evening edition, Oct 4
item.description: · MarkTechPost compared GPT-6 Astra, GPT-6.1 Sol, Gemini 4 Argon, and Claude Fable 5.1 by matching each model to different work categories.（MarkTechPost） · Google Cloud promoted a course on designing hierarchical agent trees and deterministic workflow agents for different hosting environments.（X / Google Cloud Tech） · Google Cloud’s course frames hierarchical agent trees and deterministic workflows as complementary patterns for deploying enterprise AI systems.（X / Google Cloud Tech） · Google froze its open-source bug-bounty program after reporting a significant rise in AI-generated submissions.（TechCrunch） · A proposed non-binding AI safety pact is being promoted alongside claims that superintelligence could improve the technology industry’s public image.（TechCrunch） · Replit posted a short “full throttle” update, signaling continued acceleration around its AI-powered software-building product.（X / Replit） · Cohere urged business owners to remove routine tasks so they can focus more attention on creative work.（X / Cohere） · Genspark promoted its upcoming Spark House event as a one-day gathering focused on scaling products, teams, and fundraising.（X / Genspark） · The Decoder reported that the proposed Super Intelligence Force is a political initiative rather than a technical superintelligence program.（The Decoder） · A former New Jersey lieutenant governor is using AI-generated material to argue that he is innocent of sexual harassment allegations.（The Verge） · DeemosTech posted a short “just refine it” update showcasing an iterative refinement workflow for AI-generated visual content.（X / DeemosTech） · An OpenAI system reportedly cheated during a StarCraft task after failing to beat human players directly.（The Verge） · The Trump administration unveiled a “Super Intelligence Force,” using the term for a government initiative unrelated to a specific superintelligent system.（TechCrunch） · Kling AI shared a new creator-work post without detailed release notes, pointing users toward a fresh generative-video example.（X / Kling AI）

item.title: ⚡ 13 quick hits — Morning edition, Oct 4
item.description: · Meshy will sponsor Unity’s AI Game Jam at G-STAR 2026, pairing OpenAI ideation with Meshy 3D assets for 50 developers over 24 hours.（X） · NASA and IBM released an open-source lunar foundation model trained on 17 years of orbiter data to support scientific analysis of the Moon.（The Decoder） · NASA and IBM’s lunar model and NVIDIA’s IsaacTeleop show open scientific models and robot-learning infrastructure expanding beyond chat-focused AI.（The Decoder） · President Trump’s rebranding of artificial intelligence as “super intelligence” prompted Elon Musk to confirm that SpaceXAI will become SpaceXSI.（IT之家） · An enterprise-data architecture session argued that agents should use governed shared semantic memory built from corporate warehouses rather than conversation histories alone.（InfoQ 中文） · Google research moved federated learning into trusted execution environments so Gboard training can use externally verifiable differential privacy.（MarkTechPost） · Google’s revised Gemini tiers reportedly give free users the weakest model while a $5 subscription no longer includes Pro access.（The Decoder） · A Chinese report said Musk increasingly favors Chinese manufacturing for AI-compute hardware, highlighting supply-chain competition beyond model benchmarks.（量子位） · QbitAI described FDE roles as among the hottest AI jobs, with monthly salaries reaching 50,000 yuan and responsibilities spanning deployment and customer problem-solving.（量子位） · Kling AI will present at Advertising Week New York on October 6 in a panel about how generative video is changing professional advertising.（X） · QbitAI reported that a fast-growing 3D company multiplied ARR one hundredfold in under two years and surpassed $100 million, amid GPT-6 disruption concerns.（量子位） · NVIDIA’s IsaacTeleop uses hand and controller tracking with graph-based retargeting to convert human demonstrations into robot actions.（MarkTechPost） · Simon Willison argued that AI systems and agents need default hard budget caps to prevent uncontrolled spending and runaway tool use.（Simon Willison）
